mapper.select: SELECT review_id AS reviewId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `comment` WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY review_id

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.review_id AS reviewId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%m/%d %H:%i') AS createdAtStr, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.deleted AS deleted, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_image AS profileImage FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.review_id = #{reviewId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `comment` (parent_comment_id, review_id, user_id, content, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{parentCommentId}, #{reviewId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
